objective: Add a genuinely learned/model-backed narrative extractor behind the existing source-bound provider contract and evaluate it on independent public-domain/human-adjudicated source-heldout evidence without granting canonical narrative authority.
promotion_rule: No aggregate score can promote Candidate-002. Promotion requires source-heldout evidence by task, false-certainty/ambiguity thresholds, rights provenance, evaluator-robustness compatibility and a separate explicit authority decision.
failure_rule: If the model is fluent but uncertain, contradictory or weak on a task family, reduce coverage or abstain; never normalize uncertainty into ASSERTED to improve recall.
rights_rule: Use only synthetic qualification text, verified public-domain text, or explicitly user-authorized text. No bulk copyrighted acquisition and no named-author imitation target.
aglo_isolation: Candidate-002 work must not modify the AGLO candidate, ratified master, author review dispositions, publication state or canon.

completion_delta.before: Candidate-001 proves cautious extraction plumbing on synthetic source-heldout fixtures but is not a learned provider and is not promoted.
completion_delta.after: One model-backed provider has leakage-resistant source-bound plumbing plus independent public-domain/human-adjudicated heldout evidence sufficient for an explicit promotion adjudication or a bounded failure diagnosis.
